summary_en: Upper limit 700,000 shares (6.36% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥350.0M maximum acquisition cost. Execution period 21 July 2026 to 24 March 2027 via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchase. Reason: capital efficiency improvement. Current treasury (pre-execution): 1.3M shares; 940,000 to be cancelled on 24 July 2026 and 360,000 to be disposed as RSU settlement, leaving zero treasury on 24 July 2026.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 17 July 2026, GENDAI AGENCY's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 700,000 shares of its own common stock under a statutory framework (Company Law Article 459, Section 1). The maximum acquisition cost is ¥350.0M. The execution window runs from 21 July 2026 through 24 March 2027, using ToSTNeT-3 trades and open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The stated rationale is that improved capital efficiency will enhance shareholder value. As of the resolution date, the company held 1.3M treasury shares. The disclosure notes that 940,000 treasury shares are scheduled for cancellation on 24 July 2026 and another 360,000 shares for disposal to satisfy restricted stock unit awards, reducing treasury to zero by 24 July 2026.
